claim_scope: Startup-boundary rows for Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M on the RX 7900 XTX (GPU[1]/card0/0000:10:00.0) with the repaired direct probe: cold server start, one exact-accounting request (prompt fitted to context-16 tokens, 16 greedy outputs, ignore_eos), continuous 20 ms whole-card sysfs sampling, verified device identity, effective-KV gate, and clean post-request ownership. Declared context, not a live-context ceiling.

repairs: exact prompt/output token accounting with usage and finish_reason validation
continuous 20 ms sysfs VRAM sampling through startup and the request with stage peaks
card resolved by PCI id with unique_id recorded; server-reported device cross-checked
OOM classified only from matching evidence; distinct oom_startup/hip_error/ready_timeout/request_timeout statuses
effective KV storage validated; a requested-KV fallback fails the point (kv_fallback)
post-request ownership drain with the packed-workspace lease accounted as persistent baseline

findings.startup_boundary_bf16: passes 2048 and 3072; warmup HIP OOM (error 2) at 4096 with a true sampled failure peak of 23.951 GiB (the earlier artifact's 16.9 GiB was incomplete sampling before the failure)
findings.startup_boundary_int8_qualified: with the qualified fp32 per-token/head scale contract engaged (runtime_action admit), INT8 passes 2048/3072/4096 and first fails at 5120 (warmup OOM, 23.942 GiB)
findings.int8_saving_measured: engaged INT8 peaks are 21.349/22.601/23.751 GiB versus BF16 21.869/23.328/OOM at the same contexts: the earlier 'INT8 saves no memory' row measured an unengaged fallback (fp16-scale contract miss, runtime_action fallback_bf16), not the compact route
findings.fixed_overhead_dominates: both routes share an ~18.95 GiB fixed intercept; the declared-token slope is 1.459 MiB (BF16) and 1.203 MiB (INT8) versus payload 64 KiB / 32.5 KiB, so most context-proportional memory is not KV payload (attribution is Packet 2 work; the eight-slot packed-workspace lease of max(8,N) x ceil(ctx/256) pages is one confirmed component)
findings.historical_reconciliation: the historical 112K/126K INT8 rows used the soak route with explicit fp32 scales; on current main the engaged INT8 server route was broken at startup since commit 9701985dd (eager prepare_runner resolves auto->bf16 first, then the explicit policy raises 'KV policy cannot change after preparation'); repaired in this campaign with a policy hint

limitations: Startup-boundary rows only: max-active-requests 1, no concurrency, no throughput claim, and no task-quality gate.
Peaks are 20 ms sysfs samples; sub-interval transients are lower-bounded.
The 18.618 GiB 128/24 anchor remains unrecovered; historical comparisons stay unmatched.
next: Packet 2 attribution of the fixed intercept and the context-proportional excess; then soak-route concurrency controls.
